NONE: › a person who has no home and usually no job, and who travels from place to place
流浪者；（通常指）無業遊民

example: They live a vagabond life/existence, travelling around in a caravan.
他們開著大篷車四處漂泊過活。
Compare
vagrant

NONE: › unexpected events or changes that cannot be controlled and can influence a situation
變幻無常的事件；不可捉摸的變化

example: The success of the event will be determined by the vagaries of the weather.
這場活動能否成功將取決於天氣的變化。
She had her own style and was not influenced by the vagaries of fashion.
她有自己的風格，不受潮流變幻的影響。

NONE: › the part of a woman or other female mammal's body that connects her outer sex organs to her uterus
陰道
› specialized anatomy a structure in the body that is shaped like a long close-fitting covering
（身體結構）鞘
› medical relating to the vagina (= the opening passage that leads from the vulva to the cervix)
陰道的
› anatomy relating to a structure in the body that is shaped like a long close-fitting covering
（身體部位）鞘樣結構的

example: a vaginal hysterectomy
陰道子宮切除術
a vaginal prolapse
陰道脫垂

NONE: › a condition in which a girl is born without a vagina (= the part of the body that connects the outer sex organs with the womb)
陰道發育不全

example: Vaginal agenesis can be corrected by surgery to create a functioning vagina.
陰道發育不全可以通過以手術新建一個有功能的陰道來解決。

NONE: › a person who is poor and does not have a home or job
流浪者；無業遊民；乞丐

example: The town has shelters and food handouts for vagrants.
這個鎮為流浪者提供住處和食物。

NONE: C1 not clearly expressed, known, described, or decided
含糊的，不明確的
C1 not clear in shape, or not clearly seen
（輪廓等）模糊的，不清楚的
C2 A vague person is not able to think clearly, or gives an impression of not thinking clearly in order to hide their real thoughts.
（人）迷糊的，含糊其詞的

example: I do have a vague memory of meeting her many years ago.
我確實依稀記得多年前見過她。
The patient had complained of vague pains and backache.
患者自述說隱約感到疼痛和背酸。
Through the mist I could just make out a vague figure.
透過霧靄，我只能看到一個模糊的身影。
My aunt is incredibly vague - she can never remember where she puts things.
我的姨媽極其迷糊——她老是記不得自己把東西放在甚麼地方。
Their report is studiously/deliberately vague on future economic prospects.
他們的報告故意對未來經濟前景含糊其詞。

NONE: › the nerve that supplies the heart, lungs, and most of the intestines
迷走神經
